decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s established radiation-therapy QA portfolio, with no negative market signal and likely strong fit with its calibration, service, and sales capabilities, this hardware product still looks like a worthwhile option to retain.

Because this oncology risk-management software builds on the firm’s existing integrated QA and workflow offering and can be kept on the market at relatively low carrying cost while adoption uncertainty resolves, management would likely continue it.
